annotation.notes: Q: 'What are the requirements for a risk management system for high-risk AI?' Article 9 is one process decomposed into phases, all provider + high-risk. Required core = the defining features of an RMS: OBL-RMS (documented RMS across lifecycle, the summary duty), OBL-ART9-1 (establish/implement/document/maintain), OBL-ART9-2 (continuous iterative process across lifecycle). Each paired with CONDITIONAL_ON risk:high. Supporting = concrete phases: 9-4 (residual risk acceptable), 9-5 (testing), 9-6 (testing timing), 9-7 (impact on under-18s / vulnerable groups — annotator judged supporting: too important to drop, not a defining feature of the RMS itself). Excluded: 9-3 (abstract balance-of-requirements), 9-8 (integration with other Union law) — peripheral to the core question.
